agent-tooling.description: Read-only verification tooling for agents: engine snapshot, window bridge, doctor, port resolver, Playwright fixture, coverage script. No gameplay, economy, engine/server API or UI copy changes.

server-guard.description: Server-side admission and forecast guards. Changes what the server REFUSES, never what the game pays. No economy JSON, no engine command/event, no UI.

_budget_mode: MEASUREMENT since 2026-09-24 (owner): budget ceilings (budget_usd_max, preflight_budget_usd, auto_resolve.resolve_budget_usd) are deliberately generous so no run is cut off by a cap while real costs are collected -- writer cost in ap3/state/evidence.local.jsonl (total_cost_usd, resolver_cost_usd), pre-flight cost in ap3/state/preflight/<slug>.json (cost_total). Queue tasks with budget_usd = the class budget_usd_max. Revisit once each class has ~10 runs and set each cap from the observed distribution. max_runs_per_day still bounds daily spend.
